coverageSpotVerification.detail: Sampled 17 of the 58 suite-required mappings across every attempted milestone and read each mapped test body. Every sampled mapping exercises the assertion’s actual observable, several more strictly than the assertion requires: m1-a11 decodes the rendered avatar blob and asserts naturalWidth===256 (the fixture’s exact dimensions); m2-a24 asserts the concatenation of pages 1 and 2 deep-equals the first 40 rows of the fully paged list, which is a genuine no-gap check; m5-a05 asserts the second asset fetch is denied with code E_ASSET_VIEWED; m5-a11 asserts every hit’s chat id equals its group’s chat id; m6-a13 asserts 50 verified receipts across 13 distinct verbs and runs the frozen fixture validator; m8-a01 recomputes all six totals from the export surface and then reads them off the Insights screen. Each acceptance script also asserts, at the end of its own run, that every suite-required assertion of its milestone appears in the coverage map, so the manifest cannot silently lose an entry while the suite passes. One mapping is weak rather than dishonest: m2-a13 discharges "no preview card renders" by searching for the literal text "preview card" (defect d-05); the mapped test does load and inspect the feed item carrying the link, and the grader confirmed independently that no preview element renders and that no unfurling code exists, so this is a weak assertion inside an honest mapping, not a mapping that claims coverage it does not have. No milestone is adjudicated capability-failure. Note for audit: the grader’s own re-runs of the documented entrypoint rewrote coverage-manifest.json in place (each suite regenerates its own milestone section), and the m3/m8 re-runs failed partway, so the m6/m8 sections were transiently truncated. The verdict above was taken against the delivered manifest, reconstructed verbatim from the grader’s first read of the file before any re-run, and preserved at grading/work/delivered-backup/coverage-manifest.delivered.json; it maps every suite-required assertion of all seven attempted milestones.

defects.summary: Post-create acknowledgement scales linearly with the author’s follower count, so the celebrity write path violates the frozen O5 degradation rule (≤3× a 5-follower author). At 900 followers p95 ack is 1.5–2.5 s versus 20–33 ms for a 5-follower author; the measured slope is ~1.13 ms per follower.
defects.evidence: trace.md#o5-celebrity — grading/work/results-o5-celeb.json (3 rounds, k=20 after 3 warm-ups, load recorded per round; best-of-3 ratio 3.70, median ratio ~115×) and grading/work/results-o5-curve.json (1 follower 5.83 ms, 5 followers 8.89 ms, 9 followers 11.49 ms, 900 followers 1018.46 ms median).

defects.summary: The lane’s scale-replay probe set measures read queries only (home, searchMessages, inbox, insights, trending, history, searchChat), so the frozen 2026-08-11 celebrity write-path rule was never exercised by the lane’s own performance evidence; the run record therefore reports a clean envelope.

O1.anchorsCited: Between the 60 anchor ("M1–M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap") and the 90 anchor ("every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts"), close to 90 but short of it.
O1.justification: 104 of the 119 frozen assertions pass under independent grader execution; 14 record not-run and 1 not-applicable. Every milestone this session attempted is green on the full bar (coverage-validated suite plus its web choreography segment): M1 13/13, M2 27/27, M3 15/15, M4 12/12, M5 12/12, M6 9/13, M8 16/18. That is far beyond the 60 anchor, which describes patchy later milestones. It falls short of 90 on that anchor’s explicit "including platform-proof artifacts" clause: the six iOS-simulator native-artifact assertions (m6-a01..a04 cold-start offline, m8-a17/a18 durable-queue restart) have no recording, receipts or run manifest, and the brief rules that missing evidence leaves the native proof absent rather than passing it. M7’s nine assertions also stay in the denominator scoring not-passed, per O1’s rule that never-attempted milestones keep their place there, although ENVIRONMENT.md removed M7 from this session by instruction rather than the lane failing it. Restricted to the 110 assertions this session was scoped to, the pass fraction is 104/110 = 94.5%.

O2.anchorsCited: Between the 60 anchor ("a few medium defects off the happy path") and the 90 anchor ("only cosmetic nits"), placed above 60.
O2.justification: One major defect (d-01: post-create acknowledgement scaling ~1.13 ms per follower, so a 900-follower author waits 1.5–2.5 s p95 against 20–33 ms for a 5-follower author, violating the frozen celebrity write-path rule), four minor and one cosmetic. Placement above the 60 anchor because none of the minor defects is a product fault: d-02 is an evidence-coverage gap in the lane’s own probe set, d-03/d-04 are acceptance tests that are not re-runnable (one time-bound to a single UTC day, one dependent on seeded content staying on the first rendered page), d-05 is a weak negative assertion, d-06 is a missing diagnostic. Across independent execution I found no crash, no wrong data and no broken flow: every server-side boundary I probed refused correctly (NOT_ADMIN twice, EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED, E_ASSET_VIEWED, E_ASSET_UNKNOWN for a non-member and after delete, E_AUTH on a revoked token, empty history for a removed member), set-state mutations were idempotent under retried intents, and the scheduled digest produced exact counts with every client closed. Held well below 90 by d-01, which is a real scalability violation at the published envelope rather than a nit.

O4.anchorsCited: Between the 60 anchor ("reads work; offline writes lost or mis-ordered, or receipts wrong after flush") and the 90 anchor ("reads, ordered queued writes, receipt transitions, and offline search all behave as specced on the native proof — on full runs including M8’s durable-queue restart and multi-device convergence evidence"), just above 60.
O4.justification: Scored only from the harness’s artifacts, per the applicability rule. What they demonstrate: the required m6 segment (evidence/choreo-m6-*.jsonl, pass=true) composed two messages with the context offline, asserted each bubble’s semantic receipt value was "pending", then on reconnect asserted both arrived on the second client in send order and each receipt advanced to "read" — so queued writes are neither lost nor mis-ordered and receipts are not wrong after flush, which is what the 60 anchor penalises. The m8 segment adds multi-device convergence: same-account live delivery (visibleMs 535.6), cross-device read-state clearing (864.2 ms), dual-offline convergence (flushes at 227.4 and 321.5 ms) and correct post-flush receipts. Warm-offline search passed at m5. Held far below 90 because the native proof the 90 anchor names does not exist: both segments record supplementalExternal pass:null, status:"not-recorded", and the lane produced no m6/m8-ios-screen.mp4, -receipts.jsonl or -run.json, so cold-start offline reads, previously-viewed media, cold-offline search, view-once non-caching and the durable-queue restart are unevidenced — absent rather than failing. Credit for honesty of the gap: the harness receipt, not a builder claim, is what records the absence, the lane’s README says "Native exports only", and no native claim is made anywhere; builder-authored web offline proofs exist in evidence/ but were excluded from this score.

O5.bandRationale: First-match band order 0, 30, 60, 90, 75. Band 0 does not fire: the invariant manifest conforms and the wall cap was not exhausted. All 18 per-entity counts in the lane’s final verification equal the frozen manifest exactly, and the grader independently re-verified every named O5 fixture against the retained scale store before running any write probe — u0500 following 500 and 100 conversation memberships, u0005 following 5, u0900 followers exactly 900 and 200 original posts, u0901 following 5 with the exact list [u0001,u0002,u0003,u0004,u0900], g0001 with an exact 50-member roster and exactly 10000 messages counted by full paging (200 pages). The final replay reported pass:true, so its cap was not exhausted. Band 30 fires on "any degradation rule fails": the frozen celebrity write-path rule (the celebrity’s post-create acknowledgement p95 ≤ 3× a 5-follower author’s) fails best-of-3 at 3.70, and at the median the ratio is ~115× (900-follower author 1018 ms versus 8.89 ms), with acknowledgement scaling ~1.13 ms per follower across 1/5/9/900 followers.
